title: 3D printer nozzle above a drawn bed outline
visual_facts: A black printer head assembly with a circular fan housing is suspended above a white flat bed.
The bed has a hand-drawn oval outline with a rectangular grid and several narrow shapes inside it.
A segmented black cable chain curves over the printer head and connects to its wiring.
Yellow plastic guards are visible at the left and right sides of the machine.
spatial_relations: The print head is over the upper-right part of the drawn design on the bed.
The flexible cable chain arches above and behind the head.
uncertainties: The object or design intended for printing is unclear; no printed object is visible.
